reasons.plausibility: The proposed model and mechanisms align well with established physics of phonon scattering by mass disorder and lattice distortions in high‐entropy alloys.
reasons.testability: Clear experimental measurements of thermal conductivity and comparison with baseline models provide a straightforward and decisive test of the hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: Refining predictive approaches for thermal-insulation HEAs is directly valuable to researchers optimizing alloy compositions for low thermal conductivity.
